item.title: Jotai 3.0 Ships as a Modernized, ESM-Only Package That Drops Legacy Builds and Deprecated APIs
item.description: Jotai, an atomic state management library for React, has released version 3.0.0, now exclusively using ES modules. It maintains backward compatibility but removes some deprecated APIs. Migration is straightforward for most users. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Meta Open-Sources Astryx, its Agent-Ready React Design System
item.description: Meta recently announced the beta release of Astryx, an open-source React design system developed internally over eight years. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: React Native 0.88 Release Candidate
item.description: A framework for building native applications using React - Release 0.88.0-rc.0 · react/react-native (1 source: reactstatus)

item.title: Vidact: Compiles React Components Down to Direct DOM Code
item.description: Vidact compiles React components into direct DOM code. No Virtual DOM, no React runtime. (1 source: reactstatus)
